assessment: This study will be of interest to developmental biologists who study the gene regulatory mechanisms necessary for induction and maintenance of post-mitotic neuronal identity. The authors generated a useful resource of genomic data and provided new insights into the dynamic regulation of accessible chromatin regions in post-mitotic serotonin (5-HT) neurons of the mouse hindbrain. This work proposes two transcription factors (Pet1, Lmx1b) as necessary for establishment and maintenance of accessible chromatin regions in serotonin neurons.
